workers.title: Workers
workers.help: Each worker on one of this project's batches runs in a container of its own. The tools setup script runs there first, as root. Then each repository the batch needs is cloned with its submodules, and its setup script runs as the agent in its directory. A batch may need a repository not listed here, which is cloned with no setup script, and whose pull requests a person merges. Scripts apply to the next worker that starts; who merges applies to the next look at a pull request.
workers.loadError: This project's workers could not be loaded.
workers.toolsScriptHint: Bash, run as root before anything is cloned.
workers.noRepositories: No repositories yet. Each batch clones the ones it needs, with no setup script.
workers.setupScriptHint: Bash, run as the agent in the repository once it is cloned.
workers.autoMergeHelp: On, Elysium merges a worker's own pull requests here once every check passed, no review thread is open, and nobody asked for changes, following the repository's rules. Off, a person merges them. Either way, the worker addresses every review comment.
